# a11y

## Success criteria to cite

Figures read from WCAG 2.2 on 2026-10-30; the fail lines live in `SKILL.md` `## a11y` (reflow in `responsive.md`). Cite the SC id in the evidence or fix cell.

| topic | SC, level |
|-------|-----------|
| text contrast | 1.4.3 AA |
| non-text contrast (input borders, icons, state indicators, focus rings) | 1.4.11 AA |
| label in name | 2.5.3 A |
| name and role | 4.1.2 A |
| keyboard | 2.1.1 A |
| target size | 2.5.8 AA |
| reflow | 1.4.10 AA |

## Decisions

- Why 44 is only a design target: 44 by 44 is AAA (2.5.5) and the Apple HIG hit region (44 pt); web.dev suggests about 48 px with about 8 px between targets. Design to 44 to 48; the AA line (2.5.8) is the one that fails.
- 2.5.8 exceptions, each a pass: a 24 px circle centred on the target does not overlap another target or its circle (spacing); an equivalent control of passing size exists; the target is inline in a sentence; the user agent sizes it; the size is essential.
- Name source order: visible text; `aria-labelledby` when visible text exists elsewhere; `aria-label` only for icon-only controls. Never both on one element; `aria-label` overrides `alt` and `<label>` (MDN).

## Gotchas

- `aria-label="Confirm"` on a button that shows "Save" is the 2.5.3 case in `SKILL.md`; the fix is `aria-label` removed, or a label that starts with "Save".
- An icon inside a named button gets `aria-hidden="true"`, as in MDN's `aria-label` example, so only the label is announced.
